'''Sumda Tend''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Sumda and Sumda's relative [[Jylle Tend]] bought a [[Alderaan orbital mansion|mansion in the orbit of]] Alderaan that the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan had previously used.<ref name="G2" />
